Formula u_total = 0.55*u_cls + 0.45*u_loc defined in Cell 1.0 of phase1.ipynb. Hand-fixed to place slight majority weight on classification vacuity (u_cls) because glare false alarms primarily represent semantic background confusion rather than boundary jitter.

Formula u_loc = 0.50*norm_entropy + 0.50*dirichlet_vacuity defined in Cell 1.0 of phase1.ipynb. Combines distribution spread (Shannon entropy across 16 DFL bins) and evidential evidence vacuity in equal measure.

notes_evidence: Defined in Cell 1.0 of phase1.ipynb based on Fresnel specular reflection physics on water: specular reflections are near-saturated (peak normalized RGB channel >= 0.85, ~217/255) and achromatic (low color saturation, max - min channel <= 0.20, ~51/255).

Established as the standardized diagnostic threshold for attributing a false positive box to sun glint: a detection box is categorized as a glare false alarm if at least 20% of its bounding box area intersects specular glare mask pixels.

Standard robotic deployment operating point selected a priori to maximize recall on distant small debris (>75% COCO-small in all datasets) where default conf 0.25 suppresses low-contrast items; paired with Ultralytics default NMS IoU threshold 0.65.
